description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Ex. Gaz. No. 2194/45 of 23.09.2020 - Cad. Map No. 52023 and others
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration amendments under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple entries for specific parcels of land with detailed location descriptions (block numbers, cadastral maps, village names, divisional secretary divisions, districts, and provinces). The content focuses on expunging particulars from land title registrations, which falls squarely under land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes). There is no government personnel information, organizational changes, or other specialized category content present.
